<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct J {
    bool ONLINE_JUDGE;
    istream* reader;
    ostream* writer;
    string line;
    stringstream tokenizer;
    long long start, end;
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp;
    vector<char> arr;
    const int INF = 10000000;

    J() {
        ONLINE_JUDGE = (getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") != nullptr);
        setup();
    }

    void setup() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        if (ONLINE_JUDGE) {
            reader = &cin;
            writer = &cout;
        } else {
            // For local testing, can redirect input/output if needed
            reader = &cin;
            writer = &cout;
        }
    }

    string next() {
        if (!tokenizer) {
            getline(*reader, line);
            tokenizer.clear();
            tokenizer.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        tokenizer >> token;
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    vector<int> readInts(int size) {
        vector<int> arr(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            arr[i] = nextInt();
        }
        return arr;
    }

    int getCost(const vector<char>& s, char target, int v, int k, int x) {
        int res = 0;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == 'V') {
                v--;
                if (v == 0 && target == 'V') return res;
                if (v < 0) res++;
            }
            if (c == 'K') {
                k--;
                if (k == 0 && target == 'K') return res;
                if (k < 0) res++;
            }
            if (c == 'X') {
                x--;
                if (x == 0 && target == 'X') return res;
                if (x < 0) res++;
            }
        }
        throw runtime_error("Invalid state in getCost");
    }

    void process() {
        int n = nextInt();
        string s = next();
        arr = vector<char>(s.begin(), s.end());
        int vCount = 0, kCount = 0, xCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i] == 'V') vCount++;
            else if (arr[i] == 'K') kCount++;
            else {
                arr[i] = 'X';
                xCount++;
            }
        }
        dp.assign(vCount + 1, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(kCount + 1, vector<vector<int>>(xCount + 1, vector<int>(3, INF))));
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            dp[0][0][0][i] = 0;
        }
        for (int v = 0; v <= vCount; v++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kCount; k++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= xCount; x++) {
                    for (int prevState = 0; prevState < 3; prevState++) {
                        int current = dp[v][k][x][prevState];
                        if (current == INF) continue;
                        if (v + 1 <= vCount) {
                            int cst = getCost(arr, 'V', v + 1, k, x);
                            dp[v + 1][k][x][0] = min(dp[v + 1][k][x][0], current + cst);
                        }
                        if (k + 1 <= kCount) {
                            int cst = getCost(arr, 'K', v, k + 1, x);
                            if (prevState != 0) {
                                dp[v][k + 1][x][1] = min(dp[v][k + 1][x][1], current + cst);
                            }
                        }
                        if (x + 1 <= xCount) {
                            int cst = getCost(arr, 'X', v, k, x + 1);
                            dp[v][k][x + 1][2] = min(dp[v][k][x + 1][2], current + cst);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int answer = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            answer = min(answer, dp[vCount][kCount][xCount][i]);
        }
        (*writer) << answer << "\n";
    }

    void run() {
        start = chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
        try {
            process();
        } catch (exception& e) {
            cerr << e.what() << "\n";
            exit(-1);
        }
        end = chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
        cerr << "Time: " << (end - start) << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    J solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
